parameters.content: 📥 CLIENT INTAKE — Auto-captures leads from forms, calls, and referrals. AI profiles each client and detects duplicates.
📋 AI PROPOSAL ENGINE — Claude writes proposals, tracks opens, auto-follows up. Converts 40% more leads.
📊 PROJECT AUTOPILOT — Auto-creates project boards, tracks milestones, alerts on deadlines, keeps clients informed.
💬 COMMUNICATION HUB — Centralizes all client comms. AI classifies urgency, auto-responds to FAQs, escalates the rest.
💰 SMART INVOICING — Auto-generates invoices, tracks payments, sends AI-written reminders that get progressively firmer.
📅 SMART SCHEDULING — Cal.com booking + auto-confirmation + no-show detection + meeting prep briefs.
⭐ REVIEW HARVESTER — Post-project satisfaction survey → happy clients get review requests, unhappy get intervention.
🫀 PULSE ENGINE — AI-powered Client Intelligence. Predicts churn, calculates true profitability, detects upsell opportunities. Your agency's nervous system.
🔄 SMART NURTURE — Leads who didn't convert get warm, value-first follow-ups. Churned clients get win-back campaigns.
📊 FINANCIAL COMMAND CENTER — Revenue tracking, forecasting, expense monitoring. Weekly P&L delivered to your inbox.
🚀 ONBOARDING AUTOPILOT — New client signed → automatic welcome sequence, access setup, kickoff scheduling.
❌ GLOBAL ERROR HANDLER — Catches all failures, logs everything, alerts on critical issues.
